playlists.title: Vithean Capacity Building
playlists.description: A numbered series that follows the accounting cycle from end to end — invoice, collection, bill, payment, credit note, goods receipt. Start at Ep1 and work through in order; each episode assumes the one before it.

videos.title: Ep1 Create sales invoice in Vithean
videos.author: Vithean
videos.description: When you complete a sale, create and post an invoice in Vithean to recognize revenue and generate the customer statement.  Go to Sales and select Invoices.  Click Create, then select your customer and transaction currency (KHR or USD).  Add the items or services, quantities, unit prices, and applicable VAT.  Click Approve.  Approving the invoice posts a balanced journal entry automatically—crediting revenue, recording VAT liabilities, and debiting Accounts Receivable.

videos.title: Ep2 Create sales collection in Vithean
videos.author: Vithean
videos.description: When a customer pays an open invoice, record a sales collection in Vithean to update your bank balance and clear the outstanding receivable.  Go to Sales and select Collections.  Click Create, then select the customer and payment method (Bank or Cash).  Select the open invoices being settled and enter the allocated amount.  Click Approve to post the journal entry.  Approving the collection posts a balanced journal entry automatically, crediting Accounts Receivable and debiting your Bank or Cash account.

videos.title: EP3 Create bill in Vithean
videos.author: Vithean
videos.description: When a vendor invoice arrives for goods or services, record a bill in Vithean to recognize the liability and post to your general ledger.  Go to Purchases and select Bills.  Click Create, then select the vendor and enter the bill date.  Enter the expense or inventory items, quantities, unit costs, and applicable VAT.  Click Approve to post the journal entry.  Approving the bill updates Accounts Payable and posts a balanced journal entry automatically.

videos.title: EP4  Create Payment in Vithean
videos.author: Vithean
videos.description: When you pay a vendor bill or settle an expense, record the transaction in Vithean to update your bank or cash balance and clear the outstanding liability.  Go to Banking (or Purchases) and select Payments.  Click Create, then select the vendor and payment account (Bank or Cash).  Select the open bills you are paying and enter the allocated amount.  Click Approve to post the journal entry.  Approving the payment posts the balanced journal automatically, debiting Accounts Payable and crediting your Bank or Cash account.

videos.title: EP5  Create Credit Note
videos.author: Vithean
videos.description: When a customer returns goods or requires a price adjustment, record a credit note in Vithean to adjust their balance and update inventory.  Go to Sales and select Credit Notes.  Click Create, then select the customer and invoice reference.  Enter the line items, quantities, and adjusted amounts.  Click Approve to post the journal and update the stock ledger.  Approving the credit note adjusts the accounts receivable and inventory ledger automatically.

videos.title: EP6  Create goods receipt in Vithean
videos.author: Vithean
videos.description:
EP6: Recording a Goods Receipt in Vithean  
When stock arrives at your warehouse, record a goods receipt in Vithean to update inventory balances and prepare for bill matching.  Go to Inventory and select Goods Receipts.  Click Create, then select the vendor and receiving warehouse.  Enter the items, quantities received, and unit costs.  Click Approve to post the movement to your stock ledger.  Approving the receipt updates on-hand stock immediately without rekeying data.
